title: Exact global sections on a zero-dimensional finite-type scheme
statement:
Let u be a universe, k : Type u an algebraically closed field, C : Scheme.{u}, f : C ⟶ Spec k a separated, locally finite-type, quasi-compact morphism, and assume topologicalKrullDim C ≤ 0. Then the global sections functor on abelian sheaves in universe u+1 on the small etale site of C preserves finite colimits. Together with its existing finite-limit preservation, this says global sections are exact. The site, sheaves, and global sections are [def-weil-pbc-etale-site], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and [def-weil-pbc-global-sections-functor]. No geometric points, sheaf F, or cohomology conclusion are assumed.

Exact Lean signature:
theorem zero_dimensional_global_sections_preservesFiniteColimits
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [IsAlgClosed k] (C : Scheme.{u})
    (f : C ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] (hdim : topologicalKrullDim C ≤ 0) :
    PreservesFiniteColimits (Sheaf.Γ C.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})

proof.text: Apply the Mathlib clauses of [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-dim-zero-artinian]: local finite type gives IsLocallyNoetherian C, quasi-compactness gives CompactSpace C, and the dimension bound gives IsLocallyArtinian C. Its discrete-topology instance and finite_of_compact_of_discrete give a finite discrete set of points. Define s(x) to be the canonical k-rational closed point pointOfClosedPoint f x (isClosed_discrete {x}). Its unique source point maps to x.

Apply [zero-dimensional-etale-cohomology-iso] to each sheaf F, with every geometric field equal to k and s(x) the rational point from Step 1. Cancel the two invertible derived-to-underived comparison factors using IsIso.of_isIso_comp_left. The resulting map c(F) from global sections to the product of stalks is invertible. Use piObjIso to identify the product of stalk values with the value of the product of stalk functors. Naturality of ΓRes and toPresheafFiber, checked after every product projection, makes these isomorphisms into a natural isomorphism e: Γ ≅ product_x T_x.

By [prop-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks-exact], every T_x preserves epimorphisms. A finite product of these functors preserves epimorphisms, using epi_piObj_map in WeilConjectures.Mathlib.CategoryTheory.Limits.FunctorCategory.Shapes.Products. Naturality of e transports this to Γ. Global sections preserve limits as a right adjoint, and therefore are additive by Functor.additive_of_preserves_binary_products. Apply Functor.preservesHomology_of_preservesEpis_and_kernels and then Functor.preservesFiniteColimits_of_preservesHomology to obtain the stated preservation of finite colimits. The empty point set is included by the same finite-product lemmas.

proof_origin.place: The original reduction and finite-point route is retained through zero-dimensional-etale-cohomology-iso. H1 supplies the naturality, finite-product epimorphism preservation, and right-exactness argument in Lean.
